# cose-tool Test Data

This directory contains IETF test vector key files and a sample payload for use with `cose-tool`.

## Key files

| File | Key type | Source |
|------|----------|--------|
| `es256_private.cbor` | EC2 P-256 (ES256) with private key | RFC 9052 Appendix C.7.1 |
| `es256_public.cbor`  | EC2 P-256 (ES256) public key only | RFC 9052 Appendix C.7.1 |
| `eddsa_private.cbor` | OKP Ed25519 (EdDSA) with private key | RFC 8037 |
| `eddsa_public.cbor`  | OKP Ed25519 (EdDSA) public key only | RFC 8037 |
| `aes128gcm_key.cbor` | Symmetric AES-128-GCM (16 bytes) | RFC 9053 Appendix B.2 |

Files are regenerated by `cargo run -p tps_cose_tool --bin gen-testdata`.

## Example commands

```bash
# Sign a payload with ES256
cose-tool sign1 sign --key testdata/es256_private.cbor --input testdata/payload.txt --output signed.cbor

# Verify with the public key (prints hex payload to stdout)
cose-tool sign1 verify --key testdata/es256_public.cbor --input signed.cbor

# Verify and write payload to a file
cose-tool sign1 verify --key testdata/es256_public.cbor --input signed.cbor --output payload_out.txt

# Sign with EdDSA
cose-tool sign1 sign --key testdata/eddsa_private.cbor --input testdata/payload.txt --output signed_eddsa.cbor
cose-tool sign1 verify --key testdata/eddsa_public.cbor --input signed_eddsa.cbor

# Encrypt (random nonce generated automatically)
cose-tool encrypt0 encrypt --key testdata/aes128gcm_key.cbor --input testdata/payload.txt --output enc.cbor

# Decrypt (prints hex plaintext to stdout)
cose-tool encrypt0 decrypt --key testdata/aes128gcm_key.cbor --input enc.cbor

# Decrypt and write plaintext to a file
cose-tool encrypt0 decrypt --key testdata/aes128gcm_key.cbor --input enc.cbor --output plain.txt

# Inspect a key file
cose-tool key info testdata/es256_private.cbor
```
